## Skills I'm building

**Research:** Designing survey-based research questions, conducting literature reviews, and communicating findings to academic and public audiences.

**Data Analysis:** Working with R and STATA for data cleaning, statistical modeling, data visualization, and reproducible workflows.

**Quantitative Methods:** Applying logistic regression, predicted probability analysis, and econometric methods to examine public opinion and political behavior.

**Collaboration:** Contributing to team-based research projects, documenting analyses, and presenting results to diverse audiences.

## Programming Expereince

**RStudio:** Cleaning, managing, and analyzing quantitative data in R; conducting statistical analyses; creating data visualizations; and developing reproducible research workflows.

**Stata:** Cleaning and analyzing quantitative and survey data; conducting descriptive and inferential statistical analyses; and interpreting statistical results.

**QGIS:** Managing and analyzing spatial data; performing attribute and spatial selections; and creating clear, publication-ready thematic maps.

**GitHub:** Using Git-based version control to track changes, manage repositories, document projects, and maintain reproducible research and coding workflows.

**Quarto:** Creating reproducible research reports that integrate R code, statistical results, data visualizations, and written analysis into HTML and other publication formats.
